title: Repair owned MCP duplex handshake cleanup and bounded frame acquisition
goal: Vision: V-6. Preserve public MCP host functionality while making its existing duplex transport safe to reuse for eventual ACP-supplied MCP servers; no session bridge or deadline claim.

reuse.searched: McpHost/DuplexPeer lifecycle and existing caller child kill/wait closures; susi-paths http_body::read_line_capped; wire-client and root GMCP host test fixtures; parent pinned ACP/MCP audit design.
reuse.reason: Reuse existing peer Drop ownership before first fallible operation and existing bounded-line helper. No new dependencies or external code/schema imports; retain public DuplexStreams field-move compatibility.

limitations: Bounded acquisition is a memory bound, not an I/O deadline; generic blocked read/write and cleanup closure can delay return.
Parent owns integration/publication and external coordination. Scoped local WIP commits only; no pushes or board posts.

validation.independent_review: review_gemi read-only final source review: no actionable findings
coverage: Cleanup exactly once on first initialize write/flush failure, EOF, malformed response, missing/unsupported version, initialized notification write/flush failure, duplicate ID rejection, successful disconnect and host drop
Failed initialize kills and waits for an actual still-running directly owned child; fallback cleanup prevents test orphaning
No-newline acquisition consumes at most16MiB+1 bytes; oversized frame tail cannot be reused, later request/cancel perform no additional reads/writes, sibling peer remains usable
Exactly16MiB with newline or EOF remains accepted; MAX+1 including newline is rejected; Unicode trim and strict UTF8 diagnostics preserved
Underlying InvalidData remains I/O error; ordinary JSON-RPC errors allow later successful request

source_delta.note: Correctness repair, positive measured addition; no reduction claimed, tests removed/moved, dependencies or public API changes.

optional_reduction_review: Parent authorized assessing ACP read_frame shortening, but it was deliberately not edited: std take().read_until retries Interrupted whereas the current manual fill_buf loop returns it; exact behavior parity was not established.

handoff.status: Verified; independent review clear; no external publication
